title: Change textkit.find_all: window, overlapping and case-insensitive matches
prompt:
The package textkit in the current directory has `find_all(text, sub)` (textkit/search.py), which returns the start indices of the non-overlapping occurrences of `sub` in `text`. Change it to

    find_all(text, sub, start=0, end=None, *, overlapping=False, ignore_case=False)

with this behaviour:
- Only occurrences that lie entirely inside text[start:end] count; `start` and `end` are interpreted exactly as `str.find` interprets them (negative values count from the end, values past the end are clamped). The returned indices are positions in the whole `text`, in increasing order, as a list of ints.
- overlapping=False keeps today's behaviour: after a match the search resumes after the end of that match. overlapping=True resumes one character after the start of the match, so overlapping occurrences are reported too.
- ignore_case=True matches regardless of case (the inputs are ASCII: compare the lower-cased text with the lower-cased pattern).
- An empty `sub` raises ValueError (today it loops forever).
- `overlapping` and `ignore_case` are keyword-only.

`from textkit import find_all` must keep working. tests/test_search.py has a few examples (run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`); a hidden suite checks the full behaviour. Do not modify tests/test_search.py.
